wifi not working:
WiFi Not Working - Troubleshooting Steps:

1. Check Airplane Mode
   - Press Windows + A and toggle Airplane Mode OFF

2. Restart Router
   - Unplug for 30 seconds, plug back in, wait 2 minutes

3. Forget and Reconnect to Network
   - Settings > Network > WiFi > Manage Known Networks
   - Click your network, Forget, then Reconnect

4. Update Network Drivers
   - Device Manager > Network Adapters > Update Driver

5. Reset Network
   - CMD as Admin: netsh winsock reset
   - CMD as Admin: netsh int ip reset
   - Restart computer

6. Contact IT Support ext. 1234
wifi problem:
WiFi Problem - Fix Steps:

1. Toggle WiFi off and on in taskbar

2. Restart router - unplug 30 seconds

3. Forget network and reconnect fresh
   - Settings > WiFi > Manage Known Networks > Forget

4. Update WiFi driver
   - Device Manager > Network Adapters > Update Driver

5. CMD as Admin: netsh winsock reset then restart

6. Contact IT ext. 1234
cannot connect to wifi:
WiFi Connection Issue - Fix Steps:

1. Toggle WiFi off and on in taskbar

2. Restart your router and modem (unplug 30 seconds)

3. Forget network and reconnect with correct password

4. Run Network Troubleshooter
   - Settings > System > Troubleshoot > Internet Connections

5. Update WiFi adapter driver in Device Manager

6. CMD Admin: netsh int ip reset then restart

7. Contact IT ext. 1234
no wifi:
No WiFi - Fix Steps:

1. Check if Airplane Mode is ON and turn it OFF

2. Restart router - unplug 30 seconds

3. Check if other devices can connect
   - If yes: issue is your computer
   - If no: issue is the router

4. Update WiFi driver in Device Manager

5. CMD as Admin: netsh winsock reset then restart

6. Contact IT ext. 1234
internet not working:
Internet Not Working - Fix Steps:

1. Restart Router and Modem
   - Unplug both, wait 30 seconds, replug

2. Release and Renew IP
   - CMD Admin: ipconfig /release then ipconfig /renew

3. Flush DNS
   - CMD: ipconfig /flushdns

4. Reset TCP/IP
   - CMD Admin: netsh int ip reset
   - CMD Admin: netsh winsock reset
   - Restart PC

5. Try Ethernet cable to bypass WiFi

6. Contact IT if issue persists
no internet:
No Internet Connection - Fix Steps:

1. Restart router - unplug 30 seconds

2. Check if WiFi is connected in taskbar

3. CMD Admin: ipconfig /release then ipconfig /renew

4. CMD: ipconfig /flushdns

5. Try ethernet cable instead of WiFi

6. Contact IT ext. 1234
forgot password:
Forgot Password - Recovery Steps:

1. Self-Service Reset
   - Visit reset.company.com
   - Enter employee ID and answer security questions

2. Check Email for Reset Link (check spam folder too)
   - Link expires in 30 minutes

3. Account Locked? Wait 30 minutes for auto-unlock

4. Contact IT Helpdesk
   - Call ext. 1234
   - Email helpdesk@company.com
   - Have Employee ID ready

Never share your password with anyone including IT staff
password reset:
Password Reset - Steps:

1. Visit reset.company.com

2. Enter your employee ID or company email

3. Answer security questions

4. Create new password:
   - Minimum 8 characters
   - Uppercase, lowercase, number, symbol required
   - Cannot reuse last 5 passwords

5. Update password on ALL devices:
   - Phone email app, tablet, mapped drives

6. Contact IT ext. 1234 if self-service fails
cannot login:
Cannot Login - Fix Steps:

1. Check Caps Lock is OFF

2. Type password in Notepad first to verify it is correct

3. Account may be locked
   - Wait 30 minutes for auto-unlock
   - Contact IT for immediate unlock

4. Password may be expired
   - Visit reset.company.com

5. Try PIN instead of password on login screen

6. Contact IT ext. 1234 with your Employee ID
account locked:
Account Locked - Fix Steps:

1. Why It Happens
   - 5 wrong password attempts locks account
   - Old password saved on phone causing repeated failures

2. Check Your Phone
   - Update email app with new password
   - Check all apps using company account

3. Check Credential Manager
   - Control Panel > Credential Manager
   - Remove old Windows Credentials

4. Wait 30 Minutes for Auto-Unlock

5. Contact IT for Immediate Unlock
   - Phone ext. 1234
   - Provide Employee ID for verification

6. After Unlock: Change password and update all devices
password expired:
Password Expired - Reset Steps:

1. At Login Screen
   - Press Ctrl + Alt + Delete > Change Password

2. New Password Requirements
   - Minimum 8 characters
   - Must include uppercase, lowercase, number, symbol
   - Cannot reuse last 5 passwords

3. Remote Workers
   - Connect to VPN first
   - Or visit mypassword.company.com

4. Contact IT ext. 1234 if you cannot reset yourself
change password:
How to Change Password:

1. Press Ctrl + Alt + Delete > Change a password

2. Enter current password

3. Enter new password twice
   - Min 8 characters
   - Uppercase, lowercase, number, symbol required

4. After Changing: Update on ALL devices
   - Mobile phone, tablet, any other logged-in device

5. Contact IT ext. 1234 if change fails
computer running slow:
Computer Running Slow - Fix Steps:

1. Restart Computer (especially if uptime over 2 days)

2. Disable Startup Programs
   - Ctrl + Shift + Esc > Startup tab > Disable unnecessary

3. Check CPU and RAM Usage
   - Task Manager > Performance tab
   - Close high usage processes

4. Run Disk Cleanup
   - Search Disk Cleanup > Select C drive > Clean system files too

5. Scan for Malware
   - Windows Security > Full Scan

6. Check Available Disk Space
   - Need at least 10GB free on C drive

7. Contact IT if still slow after all steps
pc is slow:
PC Running Slow - Fix Steps:

1. Restart computer first

2. Close unnecessary browser tabs and apps

3. Check Task Manager for high CPU or RAM usage
   - Ctrl + Shift + Esc > End heavy tasks

4. Disable startup programs
   - Task Manager > Startup tab

5. Run Disk Cleanup in Start menu

6. Check disk space - need 10GB+ free on C drive

7. Run Windows Defender full scan

8. Contact IT ext. 1234
laptop is slow:
Laptop Running Slow - Fix Steps:

1. Restart the laptop

2. Check what is using resources
   - Ctrl + Shift + Esc > Performance tab

3. Disable startup programs in Task Manager

4. Clean up disk space
   - Settings > System > Storage > Run Disk Cleanup

5. Check for overheating
   - Use on hard flat surface, ensure vents not blocked

6. Run Malware scan with Windows Defender

7. Contact IT ext. 1234 if issue persists
slow computer:
Computer Running Slow - Fix Steps:

1. Restart Computer First

2. Disable Startup Programs
   - Ctrl + Shift + Esc > Startup tab > Disable

3. Close high CPU or RAM programs in Task Manager

4. Run Disk Cleanup on C drive

5. Need 10GB+ free on C drive

6. Scan for Malware with Windows Security

7. Contact IT if still slow
computer freezing:
Computer Freezing - Fix Steps:

1. Force Close Frozen App
   - Ctrl + Alt + Delete > Task Manager > End Task

2. Hard Restart if Completely Frozen
   - Hold power button 10 seconds

3. Check RAM Usage in Task Manager > Performance
   - If always above 90%, need more RAM

4. Check Disk Health
   - CMD Admin: chkdsk /f C:

5. Scan for Malware

6. Check for Overheating with HWMonitor

7. Update all Drivers

8. Contact IT if freezing continues
computer keeps crashing:
Computer Keeps Crashing - Fix Steps:

1. Check Event Viewer for Errors
   - Search Event Viewer > Windows Logs > System

2. Run Memory Diagnostic
   - Search Windows Memory Diagnostic

3. Check Disk
   - CMD Admin: chkdsk /f /r C:

4. System File Repair
   - CMD Admin: sfc /scannow

5. Update all Drivers especially GPU

6. Check for Overheating

7. Contact IT immediately - may be hardware failure
laptop overheating:
Laptop Overheating - Fix Steps:

1. Place on Hard Flat Surface IMMEDIATELY
   - Never use on bed, pillow, or carpet
   - These block the air vents completely

2. Clean the Vents
   - Use compressed air on all vents
   - Do this every 6 months

3. Check CPU Usage
   - Task Manager > Performance > end high CPU processes

4. Update Drivers (graphics and chipset especially)

5. Set Power Plan to Balanced
   - Control Panel > Power Options

6. Use a Cooling Pad

7. Monitor Temperature with HWMonitor (free)
   - CPU should stay under 90 degrees Celsius

8. Contact IT if shuts down from heat - thermal paste may need replacing
laptop getting hot:
Laptop Getting Hot - Fix Steps:

1. Place on Hard Flat Surface
   - Bed and pillow block vents causing dangerous heat

2. Clean Vents with Compressed Air

3. Check CPU Usage in Task Manager
   - Close unnecessary programs

4. Set Power Plan to Balanced
   - Control Panel > Power Options

5. Use Cooling Pad

6. Check Temperature with HWMonitor
   - CPU should be under 90C

7. Contact IT - may need thermal paste replacement
my laptop is getting hot:
Laptop Overheating - Fix Steps:

   - Never use on bed or pillow as it blocks vents

2. Clean Vents with Compressed Air

3. Check CPU Usage in Task Manager > close unnecessary apps

4. Set Power Plan to Balanced in Control Panel

5. Use Cooling Pad

7. Contact IT if laptop shuts down from heat
overheating:
Device Overheating - Fix Steps:

1. Place on Hard Flat Surface

2. Clean Vents with Compressed Air

3. Check CPU Usage in Task Manager
   - Close high-usage programs

4. Change Power Settings to Balanced

5. Use External Cooling Pad

computer too hot:
Computer Overheating - Fix Steps:

1. Ensure Proper Airflow
   - Keep all vents clear
   - Use on hard flat surface only

2. Clean Dust from Vents with Compressed Air

3. Close high CPU usage programs in Task Manager

4. Set Power Options to Power Saver or Balanced

5. Monitor Temperature with HWMonitor

6. Contact IT for internal cleaning or thermal paste replacement
printer offline:
Printer Offline - Fix Steps:

1. Check Cables and Power
   - Firmly connect USB or network cable
   - Ensure printer is powered on

2. Restart Printer (off 30 seconds, then on)

3. Set as Default Printer
   - Settings > Printers > right-click > Set as Default

4. Clear Print Queue
   - Settings > Printers > Open Queue > Cancel all jobs

5. Restart Print Spooler
   - CMD Admin: net stop spooler then net start spooler

6. Remove and Re-add Printer

7. Update Printer Drivers from manufacturer website
printer not printing:
Printer Not Printing - Fix Steps:

1. Check Printer is ON and shows Ready status

2. Check Ink or Toner Levels and replace if low

3. Clear Print Queue
   - Settings > Printers > Open Queue > Cancel all

4. Set as Default Printer

5. Restart Print Spooler
   - CMD Admin: net stop spooler then net start spooler

6. Update Printer Drivers

7. Contact IT ext. 1234
cannot print:
Cannot Print - Fix Steps:

1. Check printer is ON and shows Ready

2. Check correct printer is selected in print dialog

3. Check ink or toner levels

4. Clear all stuck jobs from print queue
   - Settings > Printers > Open Queue

5. Restart Print Spooler
   - CMD Admin: net stop spooler then net start spooler

6. Reinstall printer driver

7. Contact IT ext. 1234
print quality poor:
Poor Print Quality - Fix Steps:

1. Check Ink or Toner Levels and replace if low

2. Run Print Head Cleaning
   - Printer settings > Maintenance > Clean heads 2-3 times

3. Select Correct Paper Type in print settings

4. Set Print Quality to High or Best

5. For Laser Printers: Shake toner cartridge gently

6. Use good quality paper - damp paper causes streaks

7. Update printer drivers

8. Contact IT if quality still poor
cant print to network printer:
Cannot Print to Network Printer - Fix Steps:

1. Check Network Connection and VPN

2. Ping Printer to Test Connectivity
   - CMD: ping printerIPaddress

3. Remove and Re-add Printer
   - Settings > Printers > Remove then Add by IP address

4. Update Printer Drivers from manufacturer website

5. Restart Print Spooler
   - CMD Admin: net stop spooler then net start spooler

6. Contact IT ext. 1234 for network printer issues
email not working:
Email Not Working - Fix Steps:

1. Check Internet Connection

2. Force Sync in Outlook (press F9)

3. Check Account Settings
   - File > Account Settings > verify server settings

4. Rebuild Outlook Profile
   - Control Panel > Mail > Show Profiles > Add New

5. Clear Outlook Cache
   - Delete files in %localappdata%\Microsoft\Outlook

6. Check Mailbox Size - if full emails wont sync

7. Contact IT ext. 1234
email not syncing:
Email Not Syncing - Fix Steps:

1. Check Internet Connection

2. Press F9 in Outlook to force sync

3. Check if email server is down (ask a colleague)

4. Verify account settings in File > Account Settings

5. Rebuild Outlook profile
   - Control Panel > Mail > Show Profiles

6. Check mailbox is not full

7. Contact IT ext. 1234
cannot send email:
Cannot Send Email - Fix Steps:

1. Check internet connection

2. Check Outbox for stuck emails - delete and resend

3. Check attachment size - max 20 to 25MB
   - Use file sharing link for large files

4. Verify recipient email address spelling

5. Check SMTP server settings
   - Account Settings > Outgoing Mail Server

6. Check mailbox is not full

7. Contact IT if external emails are bouncing
outlook not opening:
Outlook Not Opening - Fix Steps:

1. Force Close in Task Manager
   - End all Outlook.exe processes then reopen

2. Start in Safe Mode
   - Hold Ctrl while clicking Outlook
   - Or run: outlook.exe /safe

3. Disable Add-ins
   - File > Options > Add-ins > Disable all

4. Quick Repair Office
   - Control Panel > Office > Change > Quick Repair

5. Reset Navigation Pane
   - Run: outlook.exe /resetnavpane

6. Create New Outlook Profile
   - Control Panel > Mail > New Profile

7. Reinstall Office if nothing works
outlook crashing:
Outlook Keeps Crashing - Fix Steps:

1. Start in Safe Mode (hold Ctrl while opening)

2. Disable All Add-ins
   - File > Options > Add-ins > Manage COM Add-ins
   - Disable all, restart, re-enable one by one

3. Repair Office Installation
   - Control Panel > Office > Change > Quick Repair

4. Repair PST file
   - Run ScanPST.exe from Program Files > Microsoft Office

5. Create New Outlook Profile
   - Control Panel > Mail > Show Profiles

6. Reinstall Office completely
teams not working:
Microsoft Teams Not Working - Fix Steps:

1. Check Teams status at status.office.com

2. Clear Teams Cache
   - Close Teams completely
   - Go to %appdata%\Microsoft\Teams
   - Delete Cache, blob_storage, databases folders
   - Restart Teams

3. Sign Out and Sign In Again

4. Check internet speed - need 1.5 Mbps minimum

5. Update Teams - Profile picture > Check for updates

6. Use web version at teams.microsoft.com temporarily

7. Reinstall Teams from teams.microsoft.com
teams call not working:
Teams Call Issues - Fix Steps:

1. Check microphone permissions
   - Settings > Privacy > Microphone > Allow Teams

2. Check correct audio device in Teams Settings > Devices

3. Test audio - Teams Settings > Devices > Make a test call

4. Check internet speed at speedtest.net (need 1.5 Mbps upload)

5. Use wired ethernet instead of WiFi

6. Restart Teams completely

7. Contact IT if calls consistently fail
teams video not working:
Teams Video Not Working - Fix Steps:

1. Check Camera Permissions
   - Settings > Privacy > Camera > Allow Teams

2. Check Camera selected in Teams Settings > Devices

3. Close Other Apps Using Camera (only one app can use camera)

4. Update Camera Drivers in Device Manager

5. Restart Teams and rejoin the meeting

7. Contact IT if camera not detected at all
teams microphone not working:
Teams Microphone Not Working - Fix Steps:

1. Check Microphone Permission
   - Settings > Privacy > Microphone > Allow Teams ON

2. Select Correct Microphone
   - Teams Settings > Devices > Microphone dropdown

3. Test Microphone
   - Teams Settings > Devices > Make a test call

4. Check Default Recording Device
   - Right-click speaker icon > Sounds > Recording tab

5. Update Audio Drivers in Device Manager

6. Restart Teams completely

7. Contact IT ext. 1234
zoom not working:
Zoom Not Working - Fix Steps:

1. Check status.zoom.us for outages

2. Update Zoom - Profile icon > Check for Updates

3. Test audio and video in Zoom Settings

4. Clear Zoom cache
   - Delete contents of %appdata%\Zoom\data

5. Check firewall is allowing Zoom

6. Reinstall Zoom using Zoom Cleaner from zoom.us

7. Use web browser version as temporary fix
video call problems:
Video Call Problems - Fix Steps:

1. Check Internet Speed at speedtest.net
   - Need 3 Mbps upload for HD video

2. Use Wired Ethernet Instead of WiFi

3. Close Other Apps and Browser Tabs

4. Lower Video Quality in Settings

5. Turn Off Virtual Background (uses lots of processing power)

6. Update Camera and Audio Drivers

7. Restart the Video App and Router

8. Contact IT if quality consistently poor
vpn not connecting:
VPN Not Connecting - Fix Steps:

1. Check Internet Connection First

2. Verify VPN Username and Password
   - Check if password recently expired

3. Update VPN Client App

4. Try Different VPN Server Location

5. Disable Firewall Temporarily to test (re-enable after)

6. Reinstall VPN Client from IT portal

7. Flush DNS: CMD: ipconfig /flushdns

8. Contact IT with exact error message
vpn disconnecting:
VPN Keeps Disconnecting - Fix Steps:

1. Use Wired Connection Instead of WiFi
   - Unstable WiFi causes VPN drops

2. Change VPN Protocol
   - Switch between UDP and TCP in VPN settings

3. Update VPN Client

4. Disable Sleep/Hibernate
   - Power Options > Never sleep
   - VPN drops when PC sleeps

5. Reinstall VPN Client fresh

6. Contact IT - may be server-side issue
cannot access company resources:
Cannot Access Company Resources - Fix Steps:

1. Connect to VPN First
   - Most company resources require VPN
   - Ensure VPN shows Connected status

2. Check Your Permissions with manager

3. Check Network Drive Mapping
   - File Explorer > This PC > Map Network Drive

4. Restart Network Services
   - CMD Admin: net use * /delete then remap

5. Contact IT ext. 1234
blue screen error:
Blue Screen of Death (BSOD) - Fix Steps:

1. Note the Error Code shown on screen

2. Restart - single BSOD may be harmless

3. Check Recent Changes and uninstall new software or drivers

4. Update or Rollback Drivers (especially graphics)

5. Run Memory Test
   - Search Windows Memory Diagnostic

6. Check Disk: CMD Admin: chkdsk /f /r C:

7. System File Check: CMD Admin: sfc /scannow

8. Contact IT immediately if BSOD is frequent
blue screen:
Blue Screen Error - Fix Steps:

1. Write down the error code shown

2. Restart computer

3. Uninstall recently added software or drivers

4. Update all Drivers (especially GPU and chipset)

5. Run Windows Memory Diagnostic

6. CMD Admin: sfc /scannow

7. CMD Admin: chkdsk /f C:

8. Contact IT - frequent BSODs indicate hardware failure
bsod:
BSOD Blue Screen - Fix Steps:

1. Write Down the Error Code

2. Restart Computer

3. Uninstall Recent Software or Hardware Drivers

4. Update All Drivers especially GPU

5. Run Windows Memory Diagnostic

6. Run: CMD Admin > sfc /scannow

7. Run: CMD Admin > chkdsk /f C:

8. Contact IT - frequent BSODs indicate hardware failure
disk space low:
Disk Space Low - Fix Steps:

1. Run Disk Cleanup
   - Search Disk Cleanup > Select C drive > Clean system files too

2. Delete Temp Files
   - Windows + R > type %temp% > delete all

3. Check What Uses Most Space
   - Settings > System > Storage

4. Uninstall Unused Programs
   - Settings > Apps > sort by size

5. Move Files to OneDrive or External Drive

6. Empty Recycle Bin

7. Contact IT if consistently running low
storage full:
Storage Full - Fix Steps:

1. Run Disk Cleanup immediately
   - Search Disk Cleanup > C drive > Clean system files

2. Delete Temp Files
   - Windows + R > %temp% > delete all

3. Uninstall Large Unused Programs
   - Settings > Apps > sort by size

4. Move Documents and Photos to OneDrive

5. Empty Recycle Bin

6. Enable Storage Sense
   - Settings > System > Storage > Storage Sense

7. Contact IT to request storage expansion
hard drive full:
Hard Drive Full - Fix Steps:

1. Disk Cleanup on C drive (include system files)

2. Delete Temporary Files
   - Windows + R > type: %temp% > delete all

3. Find Large Files via Settings > System > Storage

4. Uninstall Unused Apps
   - Settings > Apps > sort by Size

5. Move files to External Drive or Cloud

6. Empty Recycle Bin

7. Contact IT for storage upgrade
software not installing:
Software Not Installing - Fix Steps:

1. Right-click Installer > Run as Administrator

2. Check System Requirements (OS version, disk space)

3. Disable Antivirus Temporarily (re-enable immediately after)

4. Restart Windows Installer Service
   - CMD Admin: net stop msiserver then net start msiserver

5. Download Fresh Copy of Installer

6. Check Event Viewer for specific error
   - Event Viewer > Windows Logs > Application

7. Contact IT - may need admin rights
app not opening:
App Not Opening - Fix Steps:

1. Restart the Computer

2. Check Task Manager - app may be running in background
   - End task and reopen

3. Run as Administrator

4. Reinstall the Application
   - Uninstall from Control Panel, download fresh copy

5. Update the Application

6. Check Windows Event Viewer for errors

7. Contact IT ext. 1234
program crashing:
Program Keeps Crashing - Fix Steps:

1. Update the Program to latest version

2. Restart Computer and try again

3. Run as Administrator

4. Reinstall the Program completely

5. Check for Windows Updates

6. Disable Conflicting Software (antivirus may interfere)

7. Check Event Viewer for crash details

8. Contact IT ext. 1234
keyboard not working:
Keyboard Not Working - Fix Steps:

1. Check Connection
   - USB: Try different port
   - Wireless: Replace batteries, re-sync receiver
   - Bluetooth: Re-pair

2. Restart Computer

3. Clean Keyboard with compressed air, check for damage

4. Update Drivers in Device Manager > Keyboards

5. Disable Filter Keys
   - Settings > Ease of Access > Keyboard

6. Use On-Screen Keyboard as temporary fix

7. Contact IT for replacement if hardware failed
mouse not working:
Mouse Not Working - Fix Steps:

1. Check Connection
   - USB: Try different port
   - Wireless: Replace batteries, check receiver
   - Bluetooth: Re-pair device

2. Clean Mouse optical sensor and use proper surface

3. Update Mouse Drivers in Device Manager

4. Try Mouse on Another PC to confirm hardware vs software

5. Contact IT for replacement
mouse not responding:
Mouse Not Responding - Fix Steps:

1. Check Connection and try different USB port

2. For wireless: Replace batteries and re-sync

3. Clean optical sensor on bottom of mouse

4. Update drivers in Device Manager > Mice

5. Try mouse on another PC to confirm hardware issue

6. Contact IT for replacement
monitor not working:
Monitor Not Working - Fix Steps:

1. Check Cables - reseat HDMI or DisplayPort firmly

2. Check Monitor Power LED - try different power outlet

3. Check Input Selection on Monitor using monitor buttons

4. Test Monitor on Another PC

5. Update Display Drivers in Device Manager

6. Try Different Display Port on PC

7. Contact IT - monitor may need replacement
monitor flickering:
Monitor Flickering - Fix Steps:

1. Check Cable Connections (reseat HDMI or DisplayPort)

2. Adjust Refresh Rate
   - Right-click Desktop > Display Settings > Advanced
   - Set to 60Hz or monitors native rate

3. Update Graphics Drivers in Device Manager

4. Move other electronics away from monitor

5. Test with Different Cable

6. Contact IT if flickering continues
screen flickering:
Screen Flickering - Fix Steps:

1. Reseat HDMI or DisplayPort cable firmly

2. Adjust Refresh Rate to 60Hz
   - Right-click Desktop > Display Settings > Advanced

3. Update Graphics Drivers

4. Move other electronics away from monitor

5. Try Different Cable

6. Contact IT if flickering continues
usb not recognized:
USB Not Recognized - Fix Steps:

1. Try Different USB Port

2. Try Device on Another PC

3. Restart Computer

4. Update USB Drivers
   - Device Manager > Universal Serial Bus controllers

5. Disable USB Selective Suspend
   - Power Options > Advanced > USB settings > Disable

6. For flash drives: Check Disk Management for drive letter

7. Contact IT ext. 1234
usb device not working:
USB Device Not Working - Fix Steps:

1. Try different USB port on computer

2. Try USB device on another computer

3. Restart computer with device plugged in

4. Check Device Manager for yellow exclamation marks
   - Update or reinstall driver

5. Disable USB Selective Suspend in Power Options

6. Contact IT if device still not detected
usb device not recognized:
USB Device Not Recognized - Fix Steps:

1. Try all available USB ports (prefer blue USB 3.0 ports)

2. Try device on another PC to confirm device vs port issue

3. Restart computer

4. Update USB drivers in Device Manager

5. Disable USB Selective Suspend in Power Options

6. Run Hardware Troubleshooter in Settings

7. Contact IT ext. 1234
no sound:
No Sound - Fix Steps:

1. Check Volume in taskbar (ensure not muted and volume up)

2. Check Volume Mixer for app-specific muting

3. Check Audio Device
   - Right-click speaker icon > Sounds > Playback
   - Set correct device as Default

4. Check physical speaker or headphone connections

5. Update Audio Drivers in Device Manager

6. Restart Audio Service
   - CMD Admin: net stop audiosrv then net start audiosrv

7. Run Audio Troubleshooter in Settings > Sound
audio not working:
Audio Not Working - Fix Steps:

1. Check Volume is not muted in taskbar

2. Set correct playback device as Default
   - Right-click speaker icon > Sounds > Playback

3. Check physical connections

4. Update audio drivers in Device Manager

5. Restart Windows Audio service
   - CMD Admin: net stop audiosrv then net start audiosrv

6. Run Audio Troubleshooter in Settings

7. Contact IT ext. 1234
microphone not working:
Microphone Not Working - Fix Steps:

1. Check Privacy Settings
   - Settings > Privacy > Microphone > Toggle ON

2. Check Default Recording Device
   - Right-click speaker icon > Sounds > Recording
   - Set correct microphone as Default

3. Check Microphone Connection (use pink jack or try different port)

4. Adjust Microphone Volume in Recording > Properties > Levels

5. Update Audio Drivers

6. Test in different application

7. Contact IT ext. 1234
headphones not working:
Headphones Not Working - Fix Steps:

1. Check Connection (firmly insert or try different USB port)

2. Set as Default Playback Device
   - Right-click speaker icon > Sounds > Playback
   - Right-click headphones > Set as Default

3. Check Volume is not muted

4. Test on Another Device to confirm headphone vs PC issue

5. Update Audio Drivers in Device Manager

6. Re-pair if Bluetooth headphones

7. Contact IT for replacement
camera not working:
Camera Not Working - Fix Steps:

1. Check Privacy Settings
   - Settings > Privacy > Camera > Toggle Allow apps ON

2. Check Physical Camera Shutter (some laptops have slide cover)

3. Enable in Device Manager > Cameras

4. Update Camera Drivers in Device Manager

5. Close Other Apps Using Camera (only one app at once)

6. Uninstall and Reinstall Camera Driver

7. Contact IT if camera not detected at all
camera not detected:
Camera Not Detected - Fix Steps:

1. Check Privacy Settings
   - Settings > Privacy > Camera > Allow apps to access camera ON

2. Check Physical Camera Shutter on laptop

3. Enable in Device Manager > Cameras or Imaging Devices

4. Update Camera Drivers

5. Test in Windows built-in Camera app

6. Uninstall driver and restart to reinstall

7. Contact IT if camera not detected
webcam not detected:
Webcam Not Detected - Fix Steps:

1. Check Camera Privacy Settings > Enable

2. Check Device Manager > Cameras section
   - If not listed: driver or hardware issue

3. Update or Reinstall Camera Driver

4. Check if another app is using camera

5. Restart PC

6. For external webcam: try different USB port

7. Contact IT ext. 1234
cannot access shared folder:
Cannot Access Shared Folder - Fix Steps:

1. Connect to VPN First

2. Check Path is Correct
   - Format: \\servername\foldername

3. Check Your Permissions with manager

4. Map Network Drive
   - File Explorer > This PC > Map Network Drive
